spans.s:
mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्)
Approximating, bringing near.
E.
नेद for अन्तिक nom. verb, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं)
1 Very near.
2 Clever.
m. (-ष्ठः)
A tree, (Alangium hexapetalum.)
E.
अन्तिक near, इष्ठन् affix of the superlative, and the form irr.; also नेदीयस् with ईयसुन् aff.

mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः)
Very near, nearest: see the last.
